title: Plan a daily diet (a linear program)
prompt:
A canteen plans one day's menu from four foods, bought in fractional servings: bread, milk, eggs, beans. Per serving the cost (euro), calories, protein (g) and calcium (mg) are:
- bread: 0.5, 250, 8, 20
- milk: 0.8, 120, 8, 300
- eggs: 1.2, 80, 6, 50
- beans: 0.6, 300, 15, 100
The day must supply at least 2000 calories, at least 60 g protein and at least 800 mg calcium. At most 8 servings of any one food may be used. Beans may provide at most 40% of the total calories of the day. Minimise the total cost.
Name the variables `bread`, `milk`, `eggs`, `beans` (servings).

Report values at the full precision the solver returns.

End your final message with one line of the form
ANSWER: {"status": "<solution status string>", "objective": <number>, "plan": {"<variable name>": <value>, ...}}
where `plan` lists every decision variable named above by exactly the name given (zeros may be left out), and `status` is "Optimal" when the solver proves optimality.
